request: What did CRS report about Medicare prescription drug price negotiation and its expected savings?

reply.reply:
CRS reported CBO’s forecast that Medicare drug-price negotiation would reduce federal Medicare drug spending by $25 billion in 2031. CBO also projected average Part D net prices would be 9% lower and Part B prices 8% lower in 2031, and selected-drug net prices would fall by about 50% on average. These are forecasts, not realized savings (CRS R47872, PDF p. 15 [printed p. 12]).
